workshops.title: How to make an Electromagnet
workshops.description: In this workshop, students will explore how an iron nail can be magnetised by making an electromagnet with simple materials that will be provided. They will build a simple electromagnet by wrapping insulated wire around the nail and connecting it to a battery. Students will be able to understand the properties of electromagnets and how to create magnetic fields with electricity.
